cms.title: Content
cms.description: Pages, legal, blog, success stories, FAQ, team and landing pages for the public website.

kindHelp.PAGE: Use the slug “about” for the founder note on the About page.
kindHelp.LEGAL: Privacy, Terms, Refund, Guarantee and Cookies. They must be published with client-approved text before launch.
kindHelp.STORY: Real students only, shared with their consent. Shown on the homepage and /success-stories.
kindHelp.FAQ: The title is the question and the body is the answer. Order with “Sort order”.
kindHelp.TEAM: Team grid on the About page.
kindHelp.LANDING: Audience pages at /for/<slug>, linked from “Who it’s for”.
